speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are presenting with shortness of breath, increased abdominal girth, and a large ovarian mass. To understand the extent of your condition, please tell me: do you have a history of cancer, and have you been experiencing bloating, early satiety, or changes in your bowel or urinary habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 40-year-old nulliparous woman. The patient reports experiencing shortness of breath and noticeable increase in abdominal size over the past month. She denies any significant medical history, previous surgeries, or use of medications.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Cancer (Advanced). The combination of a large ovarian mass, shortness of breath, and increased abdominal girth in a 40-year-old woman is highly suggestive of ovarian malignancy with likely ascites or pleural effusion. Immediate imaging and tumor markers are required to confirm stage and histology.
